advisor_identified: Lorenz Lüthi, historian of international relations and the Cold War at McGill University, supervisor of Qian Zhang.

evidence.says: McGill’s 2020 departmental newsletter, p. 17, lists Qian Zhang’s thesis, China’s India war: Sino-Indian relations, 1945-64, with Lorenz Lüthi as supervisor.
McGill’s faculty profile identifies Lorenz Lüthi as a professor and lists PhD (Yale) 2003; his teaching and graduate supervision concern international relations history.
University of Hawaii Hamilton Library’s Bruce Friend Adams finding aid, pp. 8 and 11, lists Lorenz Lüthi, The Sino-Soviet split, 1956-1966, PhD, Yale University, 2003.
In an H-Diplo review identified as by Lorenz Lüthi, McGill University, he cites his own dissertation as The Sino-Soviet Split, 1956-1966, Yale University, 2003 (p. 16, note 4).

notes: The institution, year and dissertation title match the linked AHA record; its 1956-66 date range is an abbreviated form of 1956-1966. Luethi and Lüthi are spelling variants of the same name.
